# dagsterplus_user_organization_grant (Resource)

Manages an organization-level permission grant for a Dagster+ user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dagsterplus_user_organization_grant" "alice" {
  user_id = dagsterplus_user.alice.id
  grant   = "ADMIN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user to grant access.

### Optional

- `custom_role_id` (String) The ID of a custom role to assign. Conflicts with grant.
- `grant` (String) Organization-level permission. Only `ADMIN` is accepted at the API level; for any non-admin role use custom_role_id with an organization-scoped custom role. Conflicts with custom_role_id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (the user_id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an organization-level grant for a user using the user ID.
terraform import dagsterplus_user_organization_grant.example <user_id>
```
